safety_policy: ceilings are infinite-loop guards, never evidence of stagnation or architecture incapacity

stagnation.definition: Reset streak through100K boundary; baseline at100K; eligible comparisons102K and104K. Two consecutive disjoint2K comparisons with best-val gain<0.001 AND relative mean-loss decrease<0.001. Threshold takes priority.
stagnation.supervisor_binding: X5c supervisor ruling: both comparisons after floor; earliest104K. Pre-floor evidence cannot count.

recipe.continuity: same model, optimizer and training RNG across stages
recipe.data: fresh procedural at current depth; X3 frozen val pools; validation-only selection

checkpoint_policy.best: best-val chain per stage, bound by checkpoint hashes
checkpoint_policy.boundaries: entry and exit every stage; full optimizer + NumPy/Torch/CUDA RNG
checkpoint_policy.capacity: existing X5 prune below 400GiB; retain all boundaries, each stage best, latest, every10K; audited pruning

retention: current and all lower registered depths at entry, every500, every exit

logistics.detach: nohup setsid per run; independent exclusive heartbeat lease; DONE or FAIL marker per run
logistics.wake: Supervisor-side supervised watcher exits after six DONE, or immediately nonzero on FAIL/dead PID; supervisor arms session wake. No wg services used.

claims: Observations only; no superiority claim. Local single-GPU task probes; no DiLoCo/Slurm claim; R16 evidence discipline only.
regression: tests/test_replay_stagnation_rule.py; original raw e97_T1/gdn2_T1 validation.json+training.jsonl; both90% and97%; rejected archived rule negative control
